external_rollout_evidence.policy: V6 raw source/continuation references remain in the verified v6 archive; only the pinned training numerical inputs and evidence identities are packaged here.

recovery_policy.restore: Absent v7 run only; preserve current source and conflicting/newer evidence. No identity rebasing. Relocation or mismatched dependencies creates STOP.
